tours.name: Atlantis Aquaventure
tours.short_description: Slide into a pool of fun and meet the magical creatures of the sea.
tours.about: Slide into a pool of fun and meet the magical creatures of the sea. Get your pulse racing on any of the 105 slides and attractions or kick back on the beautiful private beach at, Atlantis Aquaventure, the largest waterpark in the Middle East & Europe.
tours.full_description:
The Trident Has Risen! Get splashin’ at the largest waterpark in the world with the launch of Trident Tower, Splashers Lagoon and Splashers Cove, NOW open with 28 new record-breaking waterslides and attractions.

Aquaventure Waterpark promises a world of excitement to make you feel #DifferentInWater in more ways than one.

Get your pulse racing with 105 slides and incredible attractions and experiences, make your way through the Raging Rapids and relax on 1km of private beach.

Young families will enjoy the safety of Splashers’ Kids Play Area, a dream attraction for families for non-stop splashin’ FUN, while animal lovers can get up close with dolphins, sea lions, sharks and stingrays.

Enjoy over 22 fun-filled hectares of record-breaking fun for all ages.
tours.image_alt: Guests enjoying a water slide at Atlantis Aquaventure
tours.pickup_information: Transfers to and from your hotel or residence are not included.
tours.highlights:
Day pass to Aquaventure Water park - largest water park in the Middle East & Europe.
Record-breaking waterslides at the all-new Trident Tower
Over 30 Rides and Attractions - Enjoy over 22 fun-filled hectares of record braking fun for all ages.
Splashers Kids' Play Area - A dream attraction for children for non-stop splashin' FUN.
Lost Chambers Aquarium with over 65,000 marine creatures
Interactive, educational and entertaining Aquatheatre show
tours.know_before_you_go:
Suitable for all ages. Participants under 12 years old must be accompanied by a paying adult (18 years and above). A maximum of 3 children under 12 years per adult is accepted. Select an adult ticket if you are 3 feet 11 inches (120 cm) or taller; otherwise, select a child ticket.
Locker and towel rentals are available within the waterpark.
Visitors are not allowed to bring food, beverages or glassware into the waterpark. Aquaventure Waterpark reserves the right to inspect all bags for any such items. Appropriate swimwear is required when using the facilities within Aquaventure and the beach thongs, transparent bathing suites, underwear, denims, very loose clothing such as abaya, dishdash or similar are not permitted in the water.
Regular nappies/diapers are not allowed in any pool or attraction. Swim nappies / diapers are available in all gift shops.
If you are pregnant or has any severe medical conditions, you should carefully consider whether to participate.
You must be able to understand the safety instructions, which are conducted in English.
Guests with Dolphin Bay and Sea Lion bookings made on the mentioned closure dates will receive an Aquaventure Waterpark voucher once guests checks-in for the activity. Guests may use this voucher to access the Aquaventure Waterpark on a different day within 1 month from the time it was issued.
For Aquaventure Super Pass, the tickets need to be redeemed at the Aquaventure first in order to get access for both areas. The guest then have to keep the wristband with them in order to gain entry to Lost Chambers should they decide to visit the Aquarium after enjoying the park.
For those who have booked Aquaventure Super Pass or Lost Chambers Pass, we recommend to visit the Aquarium in the morning between 10:00 AM – 01:00 PM to avoid inconvenience.
Operating timings of Aquaventure Waterpark are from 10AM until 6PM
Please note that in high season such as school holidays, winter holidays or Easter holidays the queues to the rides might be long. Depending on availability the AquaXpress can be purchased at the entrance or at the guest service kiosk inside the park.
tours.age_policy: Suitable for all ages. Participants under 12 years old must be accompanied by a paying adult (18 years and above). A maximum of 3 children under 12 years per adult is accepted. Select an adult ticket if you are 3 feet 11 inches (120 cm) or taller; otherwise, select a child ticket.
tours.cancellation_policy: Tickets for Atlantis Aquaventure cannot be cancelled, transferred or refunded

tours.name: IMG Worlds of Adventure
tours.short_description: Thrilling rides, numerous roller coasters, live shows and amazing attractions - all crammed into five action-packed zones.
tours.about:
Thrilling rides, numerous roller coasters, live shows and amazing attractions - all crammed into five action-packed zones. Discover Marvel, explore the Lost Valley and Dinosaur Adventure, Cartoon Network, IMG Boulevard and The Haunted Hotel.

The newest addition to the awesome experiences is the Kids Zone ready to welcome the younger family members.
tours.full_description:
IMG Worlds of Adventure is Dubai s first mega-themed entertainment destination promising visitors from around the world the excitement of five epic adventure zones in one location.

Two of the five zones represent renowned global brands Cartoon Network and Marvel, while The Haunted Hotel, IMG Boulevard and the Lost Valley – Dinosaur Adventure zones are original concepts created by the IMG Group. IMG Worlds of Adventure is the largest temperature-controlled indoor themed entertainment destination in the world, covering an area in excess of 1.5 million square feet.
tours.image_alt: Guests riding a dinosaur-themed roller coaster at IMG Worlds of Adventure
tours.pickup_information: Transfers to and from your hotel or residence are not included.
tours.highlights:
Discover five epic adventure zones based on the park's top themes - Marvel, Cartoon Network, IMG Boulevard, The Lost Valley and Haunted Hotel
Meet your favourite superheroes, Cartoon Network characters, and even dinosaurs, who have come to life at this exciting park
Explore over 1.5 million square feet of theme park featuring a unique array of 22 adrenaline-filled rides, roller coasters and thrilling rides
Explore themed lunches, indulge in some novelty shopping and discover the fascinating artwork at the shops within the world’s largest indoor theme park
tours.know_before_you_go:
Ensure that you are carrying a valid ID of the members in your group if you select any reduced price tickets during checkout.
Children below 1.05 meters in height are eligible for free entry to the Park.
Opening hours are subject to change. Closing times indicate the times queues close.
Attraction queues will close at park closing time (not the ride) with the exception of the Haunted Hotel which has limited capacity and will close up to 2 hours before park closing time should the queue line reach its maximum capacity.
Haunted Hotel is only open to guests aged 15 and older. Aged 15 to 18 years must present their ID card at the attraction entrance.

tours.name: Wild Wadi Waterpark
tours.short_description: Wild Wadi is all about fun and making our guests’ day memorable.
tours.about: Wild Wadi is all about fun and making our guests’ day memorable.
tours.full_description:
Located by the stunning Burj Al Arab, the Wild Wadi Waterpark is a fun-themed park, based on popular characters from Arabian folklore, Juha & Sinbad. The park is filled with 30+ rides and attractions and is the perfect family getaway! Up the excitement at the stormy Tantrum Alley and take an exhilarating plunge down 105-foot Jumeirah Sceirah. Float along lazily on Juha’s Journey, or take on the more thrilling rides. There is something for everyone here.

You can also browse for souvenirs or other articles in the shops on the premises of the Wild Wadi Water Park.

tours.pickup_information: Transfers to and from your hotel or residence are not included.

Two artificial surfing machines
18 m (59 ft) waterfall that goes off every ten minutes
Two gift shops
Three restaurants
Two snack stands

Appropriate swimwear MUST be worn at all times regardless of age. Fully body swim suits and long sleeved rash vests are acceptable on all rides. Management reserves the right to determine whether or not swimwear is appropriate

Children under age 13 MUST be accompanied by an adult. Infants below two years are free of charge.

tours.name: Dubai Airport Transfers
tours.short_description: Schedule your one-way private transfer to or from any terminal at Dubai International airport.
tours.about: Schedule your one-way private transfer to or from any terminal at Dubai International airport. Travel in comfort and enjoy your pre-booked pick up or drop-off between the airport and any hotel or residence in Dubai for the fixed price of AED 125.
tours.full_description:
Enjoy convenient transfers in Dubai. Our pre-booked service includes pick up or drop-off between any terminal at Dubai International airport and any hotel or residential address across the city.

Our airport transfers are reserved just for you and your group, so you don’t need to share with any other passengers. The service is also door-to-door with a fixed price, making your journey easy and stress-free.

To request this service, please enter your details and a member of our team will be in touch with you to confirm your booking.

Please note, this service is only available in Dubai. Pick up and drop-offs in other emirates are not available.
tours.image_alt: Passengers welcomed beside an airport transfer van
tours.pickup_information: Door-to-door transfer between DXB Terminals 1, 2 or 3 and Dubai city hotels/residences. Book at least 24 hours in advance; maximum 4 passengers.
tours.highlights:
Door-to-door service
Private vehicle for up to 4 passengers
DXB terminals 1, 2 and 3
VIP arrival support at Terminal 3
tours.know_before_you_go:
Valid for Dubai city locations only
Maximum 4 passengers per vehicle
Luggage allowance: up to 3 large suitcases + 3 hand luggage per vehicle
Bookings must be made at least 24 hours in advance
Baby car seats are available on request
Transfers valid to/from DXB airport terminals 1, 2, and 3
If you’re arriving at Dubai International Terminal 3, you’ll need to wait for your assigned vehicle at the Arabian Adventures desk at the Emirates Hotel Lounge located in the arrivals hall. A member of our team will have a name board ready to welcome you after you exit the baggage claim area and be available to assist you
If you’re arriving at Terminals 1 or 2, your driver will meet you at the arrivals hall and assist you to your assigned vehicle
For arrival assistance, please contact our airport team on 050 456 6716
tours.additional_notes:
What's included:
Door-to-door service
Private vehicle for up to 4 passengers
VIP arrival support at DXB Terminal 3
Trusted Arabian Adventures drivers and assistants
Fixed price AED 125 per vehicle, not per adult.
VIP arrival support is specified for DXB Terminal 3; Terminal 1/2 meeting arrangements differ as described above.
This product is not available for online bookings. Request a callback or WhatsApp +971 42748803 to book.
